jobs.description:

This position will support our continued growth by demonstrating the Precision FTZ software platform to prospective clients and helping new clients successfully implement our solution.

The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of FTZ operations, excellent communication skills, and the ability to guide clients through software demonstrations, implementation, training, and onboarding.

* Explain how Precision FTZ supports FTZ operations, compliance, inventory control, admissions, entries, and reporting.
* Learn each prospective client’s business processes and demonstrate solutions that address their operational needs.
* Work closely with Precision FTZ’s growing implementation team to onboard new clients.
* Gather, document, and communicate client requirements.
* Assist with implementation planning, system configuration, testing, and validation.
* Coordinate with clients, developers, brokers, consultants, and other project stakeholders.
* Help clients prepare for user acceptance testing and production go\-live.
* Provide system training and operational guidance to new clients.
* Track implementation tasks, deadlines, risks, and outstanding issues.
* Maintain clear and professional communication throughout the sales and implementation processes.
* Support clients during implementation and post\-go\-live transition.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* At least three years of professional Foreign\-Trade Zone experience.
* Working knowledge of FTZ operations and U.S. Customs and Border Protection requirements.
* Ability to work Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time.
* Strong presentation and public\-speaking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and project\-management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple client implementations and competing priorities.
* Comfortable learning, demonstrating, and supporting business software.
* Ability to work effectively with clients, technical teams, and business stakeholders.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience implementing or using FTZ inventory control and recordkeeping software.

The successful candidate will be self\-motivated, dependable, professional, and comfortable working directly with both prospective and existing clients. **About Precision FTZ**

Precision FTZ provides specialized Foreign\-Trade Zone inventory control and recordkeeping software designed to help companies manage FTZ operations efficiently and maintain regulatory compliance. jobs.title: Charm Health Account Implementation Optimization Specialist
jobs.description:
Charm Health Account Implementation Optimization Specialist Position Overview

Charm Experts is seeking a senior, client\-facing **Charm Health Account Implementation Optimization Specialist** to lead the setup, implementation, training, and ongoing optimization of CharmHealth EHR accounts for medical practices.

This position requires more than general familiarity with the platform. The successful candidate will take ownership of implementations following the initial sale, assess each practice’s clinical and administrative needs, translate those requirements into an effective CharmHealth configuration, and guide the client from discovery through go\-live and post\-launch stabilization.

Our clients range from solo providers launching new practices to established, multi\-provider organizations migrating from other EHR platforms or seeking to improve their existing CharmHealth environment.

Position Type

This position will initially be structured as a part\-time independent contractor engagement, with the potential to transition into full\-time employment based on performance, client demand, and company growth.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead client discovery, kickoff, implementation, and workflow\-planning meetings.
* Evaluate each practice’s clinical, administrative, scheduling, billing, and patient\-engagement requirements.
* Develop tailored implementation plans, timelines, and task lists.
* Configure new and existing CharmHealth accounts, including:
* Practice, facility, provider, and staff settings
* Roles, permissions, and user access
* Appointment types, scheduling rules, and provider calendars
* Clinical workflows and encounter settings
* Custom charting and specialty\-specific clinical templates
* Intake forms, questionnaires, consent forms, and patient communications
* Patient portal registration and workflows
* Telehealth services
* E\-prescribing and EPCS coordination
* Laboratory and imaging integrations
* Diagnosis, procedure, medication, and laboratory preference lists
* Billing, coding, payment, and clearinghouse workflows
* Support patient\-data migration and validate the accuracy and completeness of imported records.
* Coordinate third\-party integrations and communicate with CharmHealth, clearinghouses, laboratories, pharmacies, and other vendors as needed.
* Train providers, practice administrators, clinical staff, and front\-office personnel.
* Create written implementation documentation, workflow guides, and training materials.
* Manage multiple client projects, priorities, deadlines, and deliverables simultaneously.
* Provide go\-live support, troubleshooting, and post\-launch stabilization.
* Conduct post\-implementation reviews and recommend improvements to workflows, templates, reporting, and system utilization.
* Maintain clear, timely, and professional communication with clients throughout each engagement.
* Identify opportunities for workflow automation, API integrations, analytics, and continued account optimization.

Required Qualifications

* Five or more years of EHR implementation, configuration, onboarding, or optimization experience.
* Substantial direct, hands\-on experience with the CharmHealth EHR and practice\-management platform.
* Demonstrated ability to configure CharmHealth accounts for real\-world medical\-practice operations.
* Experience translating clinical and administrative workflows into efficient system configurations.
* Strong understanding of medical\-practice operations, including scheduling, documentation, patient intake, prescribing, laboratory workflows, billing, and revenue\-cycle processes.
* Experience developing clinical templates, intake forms, questionnaires, consent forms, and standardized workflows.
* Experience training clinical and nonclinical users with varying levels of technical proficiency.
* Strong project\-management, organizational, documentation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent client\-facing communication and consultative skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and take ownership of projects from discovery through stabilization.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA requirements and the proper handling of protected health information.

Strongly Preferred

* Approximately five years of direct CharmHealth implementation and optimization experience.
* Experience implementing CharmHealth across multiple specialties or practice types.
* Experience working with solo providers, startup practices, telehealth organizations, and multi\-provider medical groups.
* Experience with patient\-data migration and EHR transition projects.
* Knowledge of CharmHealth billing, eClaims, clearinghouse, and revenue\-cycle workflows.
* Familiarity with CharmHealth APIs and third\-party integrations.
* Experience with workflow\-automation and analytics platforms such as Zoho, n8n, or comparable systems.
* Experience developing reusable implementation standards, checklists, training programs, and account\-optimization plans.

What Success Looks Like

The successful specialist will be able to take a new client from an initial requirements discussion to a properly configured, documented, and stable CharmHealth environment. Providers and staff should be prepared to use the system confidently at go\-live, with efficient workflows supporting patient care, practice operations, billing, compliance, and future growth.

To Apply

Please provide:

* A résumé or summary of your relevant professional experience
* A two\- to three\-minute video introducing yourself and describing your experience working with CharmHealth
* The number of years you have worked directly with CharmHealth
* Examples of CharmHealth implementations, configurations, or optimization projects you have completed
* The types and sizes of medical practices you have supported
* Examples of clinical templates, forms, workflows, integrations, or training programs you have developed
* Your availability and preferred engagement structure
* Your hourly rate or compensation requirements

Pay: $67,964\.52 \- $81,849\.74 per year

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Client Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**CLIENT ONBOARDING ENGINEER**



Location: Nashville, In Office



Operations / Project Services



Reports to VP of Operations



Full\-Time, Exempt


**POSITION DESCRIPTION**



The Client Onboarding Engineer owns the new\-client experience from initial assessment through service handover. Before this role engages, a separate engineering team completes a formal assessment covering networking, core infrastructure, and major systems such as accounts and servers. You pick up from that foundation and go deeper — into the day\-to\-day technical operations the initial assessment doesn't reach: how the client actually provisions users, manages devices, handles printing, and runs the workflows their staff depend on.



For the critical first weeks of each client relationship, this role is the single point of contact; directing the work, delivering hands\-on technically, and answering for the result. This work occurs on a structured cadence: welcome and discovery, coordinated on\-site delivery, and a documented handover to our service desk. This role blends technical execution, disciplined documentation, and steady client communication.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


**Onboarding Ownership**


* Own each client onboarding end\-to\-end: welcome call through service handover


* Set and hold scope expectations with the client from day one


* Track and escalate external dependencies — vendor approvals, credential handover, outgoing\-provider access



Discovery \& Documentation


* Run on\-site and remote discovery of the client's environment, pain points, and operational workflows


* Build environment documentation in real time: network diagrams, credential records, site detail, and process notes — written for the technician who will rely on it under pressure


* Coordinate with outgoing IT providers to ensure continuity and close documentation gaps


**Operational Assessment \& Standards**


* Starting from the initial assessment completed by our engineering team, extend the evaluation into day\-to\-day technical operations: user provisioning, device lifecycle, roster management, printing, and end\-user workflows


* Complete the client's full assessment against TL's gold standard, reconciling what the initial assessment predicted against what is actually found on site


* Deliver the completed assessment and supporting evidence to the architecture team for long\-term roadmap development


**On\-Site Delivery**


* Plan and execute on\-site engagements: device counts, staffing, imaging approach, and staged prerequisites


* Direct on\-site technicians and contractors — assign work, check quality, keep the schedule


* Verify all in\-scope devices are enrolled in management before leaving site


**Transition \& Handover**


* Lead the service desk handover briefing: environment specifics, known issues, deliberate exceptions, recurring patterns


* Deliver end\-user training and set support expectations


* Serve as escalation bridge through the first support period after go\-live


* Brief the account team on decision makers, communication preferences, and commitments made during onboarding


**QUALIFICATIONS**


**Required**


* 3\+ years in technical support, service desk, or IT project delivery with genuine hands\-on capability


* Working knowledge of SMB or K–12 environments: networking, Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace identity, endpoint management, security stack basics


* Practical endpoint and device management experience — and the judgment to distinguish a configuration problem from a data problem


* Strong written and verbal communication: clear technical explanations for non\-technical audiences, documentation another technician can act on unaided


* Comfortable leading client\-facing meetings and holding a scope boundary


* Willingness to travel for on\-site client engagements


**Preferred**


* Prior MSP or K–12 technology experience


* Hands\-on MDM / endpoint management across platforms (Intune, Mosyle, Addigy, Jamf, Google Admin)


* Familiarity with SIS rostering, identity sync, and the failure modes that come with it


* Experience with PSA tools and documentation platforms


* Understanding of education compliance frameworks (FERPA, CIPA, SIPA)


**WHO THRIVES HERE**


* Relentlessly follow\-through oriented — you don't leave tasks in limbo or need to be reminded twice


* Chases what's needed — credentials, access, approvals — rather than waiting to be handed it


* Treats documentation as a product, not a chore


* Writes down what is actually wrong, plainly, including the inconvenient parts


* Energized by variety — no two client environments are the same, and that's a feature


* Accountable to outcomes, not activities — a cleanly onboarded, documented, supported client is the measure

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Implementation Specialist (Remote)**
======================================


**Build the System That Launches an Industry**
----------------------------------------------


Nest Veterinary is on track to 5X this year. We're the category leader in care plan infrastructure for veterinary practices — and every new hospital that joins our network goes live because of the work our Implementation team does. If you love building processes, owning outcomes, and making complex launches look effortless, this role was made for you.

**About Nest Veterinary**


Our mission is simple: make pet care accessible to every pet parent. We provide fully\-managed, tech\-enabled care plan solutions that help veterinary practices increase compliance, drive revenue, and deliver better preventive care — without the administrative burden.


We're transforming an industry, and we're doing it with design\-forward products and a team that genuinely cares about the outcome.

**The Role**
------------


As an Implementation Specialist, you're the engine behind every successful hospital launch. You'll orchestrate the onboarding process from kickoff to go\-live — coordinating logistics, validating readiness, and ensuring every technical and operational detail is locked in before launch day.


But this role goes beyond project management. You'll also be a key trainer and coach for the practices you onboard, preparing hospital teams to confidently integrate care plans into their daily offerings. You'll work hand\-in\-hand with Hospital Success Managers to make sure practices don't just go live — they go live ready.


At Nest, implementation isn't a back\-office function. It's one of the most visible, high\-impact roles in the company.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Implementation Leadership**


Own the launch. You'll serve as project lead for new hospital onboarding — driving timelines, managing deliverables, and co\-leading rollouts alongside Hospital Success Managers to ensure a seamless, coordinated experience for every practice.

### **Practice Training \& Readiness**


Prepare hospital teams to succeed with care plans from day one. You'll deliver training sessions that equip veterinary staff with the knowledge, confidence, and workflows they need to successfully introduce care plans as part of their practice offerings — making the transition feel natural, not disruptive.

### **Logistics \& Readiness Coordination**


Execute the behind\-the\-scenes work that makes launches run smoothly. You'll manage scheduling, resource allocation, and communication flow; confirm all readiness checkpoints before go\-live; and align internal teams, vendors, and hospital staff so nothing falls through the cracks.

### **Technical Review \& Validation**


Be the checkpoint owner. You'll conduct readiness reviews to verify integrations, configurations, and systems are launch\-ready; coordinate with Engineering, clients, and Support on any outstanding requirements; and document all technical and logistical sign\-offs for a clean handoff.

### **Cross\-Team Collaboration**


Your work doesn't end at launch. You'll partner with Hospital Success Managers throughout the onboarding lifecycle, support a smooth transition to the ongoing support team, and bring post\-launch insights back to Product, Engineering, and Hospital Success to continuously improve the process.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 2\+ years in SaaS implementation, operations, or project management (veterinary or healthcare experience is a plus)
* Experience training or enabling client\-facing teams — you know how to make complex concepts click
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate logistics across multiple stakeholders and keep projects on track
* Epic organizational skills with a track record of meeting deadlines in fast\-moving environments
* Excellent communicator — clear and confident with both internal teams and hospital staff
* Familiarity with veterinary practice workflows or healthcare systems is a plus
* Startup experience preferred — you're comfortable building as you go and raising your hand when something could be better
* Familiarity with CRM Database workflows

**Why Nest**
------------

* 5X growth trajectory — your work will directly shape how we scale
* High visibility role — every hospital launch has your fingerprints on it
* Mission that matters — more pets getting the preventive care they need because practices are set up to succeed
* Ground\-floor opportunity — help define what great implementation looks like at a category\-leading company
* Teammates who show up — kind, motivated, and genuinely collaborative

*Nest is an equal\-opportunity employer. You are welcome at Nest for who you are, no matter where you come from or what you look like. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. Bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It's in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing veterinary health care and help pets live longer, healthier, and happier lives.*

  

Compensation Range: $75K \- $80K

jobs.description:
**Company**

ApprentiScope is the leading workforce\-management platform purpose\-built for Registered Apprenticeship programs, with customers ranging from Fortune 500 companies to state governments. Our core platform replaces labor\-intensive manual processes, enabling these organizations to scale their programs, reduce compliance burden, and generate measurable outcomes. As AI expansion and energy infrastructure modernization make the skilled trades an ever\-increasing national priority, that demand is accelerating, and ApprentiScope is positioned to define the category.

**Role Overview**

Onboarding Specialists own every new customer's journey from signed contract to go\-live. You'll run our largest implementations end to end: building project plans, coordinating data migrations, standing up SSO, and guiding customer IT and security stakeholders through technical rollouts. At the same time, you'll build the scaled onboarding motion for our smaller customers: cohort kickoffs, group training, and self\-serve resources that cut time\-to\-launch without cutting quality. You're our first dedicated onboarding hire, which means you'll inherit a live queue of active implementations and build the system while running it. At go\-live, you hand each customer to a Customer Success Manager who owns the ongoing relationship, renewal, and expansion. Your job is to get every customer to that handoff quickly, configured correctly, and confident in the product. The role sits at the intersection of project management, technical configuration, and teaching.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Onboarding \& Implementation*

* Own new customer onboarding from contract signature to go\-live: build the project plan, set milestones, coordinate stakeholders, and deliver on schedule
* Run enterprise implementations end to end: SSO and identity setup (SAML, Microsoft Entra, Okta), data migration, security and IT coordination, and phased rollouts across programs and locations
* Configure each customer's environment around their program structure and compliance requirements, including RAPIDS workflows, coordinating internally on data migration and integrations
* Deliver role\-based training that makes program sponsors, administrators, and field staff self\-sufficient quickly
* Track time\-to\-launch and clear blockers proactively; no project stalls without a named owner and a next step

*Scaled Onboarding*

* Design and run the one\-to\-many motion for smaller customers: cohort kickoffs, live group training, and office hours
* Build the templates, guides, and self\-serve resources that reduce per\-customer onboarding hours every quarter
* Turn what you see in the field into a prioritized friction list for the product team: what should be self\-serve, what should be automated, what confuses customers

*Systems \& Handoffs*

* Define and enforce the go\-live gate: a completion checklist plus a first adoption milestone before any account moves to steady state
* Bring the account's CSM in at kickoff so every customer meets their long\-term owner on day one
* Own onboarding metrics and report them weekly: time\-to\-launch, active project count, go\-live rate, and aging on anything stalled
* Build the onboarding playbook (project templates, milestone plans, training curriculum) as an early member of a growing team

**Skills \& Qualifications**

* 4\+ years in implementation, onboarding, professional services, or technical project management at a B2B SaaS company
* Proven ability to run 10\+ concurrent implementations: multi\-stakeholder coordination, milestone tracking, and on\-time delivery
* Hands\-on experience with technical implementation work: SSO and identity providers (SAML, Entra, Okta), data migration, and integrations, comfortable working directly with customer IT teams
* Experience running enterprise rollouts: security reviews, IT and procurement stakeholders, multi\-month timelines
* Experience building or running one\-to\-many onboarding: cohorts, webinars, templated implementations
* Comfort with data: tracking cycle times and capacity, maintaining CRM hygiene (we run on HubSpot)
* Aptitude for developing deep technical product knowledge (configuration, integrations, workflows) and learning a regulated domain: Registered Apprenticeship compliance
* Training and facilitation skill: can teach a room of field users or a C\-suite sponsor with equal clarity
* Writes documentation other people can actually run: project plans, status updates, playbooks

**Behavioral Traits**

* Structured operator: runs a dozen concurrent projects without letting details slip
* Finisher: allergic to stalled projects; drives every implementation to go\-live and closes every loop
* Builder: documents as they go and turns anything done twice into a template
* Proactive, not reactive: customers and teammates always know the status and the next step
* Boundary\-disciplined: protects the project plan, flags scope creep early, and hands off cleanly instead of holding on
* Composed under pressure: keeps priorities straight when timelines compress and multiple accounts need attention at once
* Intellectually curious: genuinely wants to master a complex, compliance\-driven product and domain

**Benefits**

* Health Insurance (Medical, Vision \& Dental)
* Educational, Bereavement \& Parental leave
* 20 days paid time off
* Work from home stipend

**Compensation**

jobs.title: Project Manager - Client Onboarding
jobs.description:
**Project Manager, Client Onboarding**



CrelioHealth Inc. · Remote (United States) · Full\-time · Travel to client sites (\~25–40%)



Compensation: $95,000 – $120,000 base, depending on experience \+ performance incentives (including incentives on expansion or referral opportunities you help close). Benefits include health coverage and PTO.


**About CrelioHealth**



CrelioHealth builds cloud\-based laboratory information systems (LIS/LIMS) that power diagnostic labs across the United States and 2,500\+ labs worldwide. Our platform runs the full lab workflow — from order booking and specimen tracking through result reporting, patient engagement, billing, and inventory — for physician office labs, hospital labs, reference labs, and direct\-to\-consumer testing companies. We are HIPAA\-compliant, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified, and growing quickly in the US market.


**The Role**



When a lab signs with CrelioHealth, you are the person who turns that signature into a running lab. You will own client onboarding end to end: planning the implementation, configuring the rollout with our product and support teams, training lab staff, managing the go\-live, and making sure the client is delighted enough to expand and refer. You are the face of CrelioHealth from kickoff to steady state.


**This is not a sales role.** You carry no quota and you will never cold\-call. But onboarding is where trust is built, and trust is where growth comes from. We want someone who can confidently present the platform, handle a skeptical lab director, and spot the moment a client is ready for another module or another location — and who earns incentives when those opportunities convert.


**What You Will DoOwn implementations**


* Lead onboarding projects for new US clients — single\-site labs through multi\-location networks — from kickoff through go\-live and handover to support.
* Build and run the implementation plan: scope, milestones, data migration, instrument interfaces, integrations (EHR/EMR, billing, HL7/FHIR), user setup, and validation.
* Coordinate internal teams (product, engineering, support) and client stakeholders (lab directors, pathologists, techs, front\-desk, billing, IT) to keep every go\-live on schedule.
* Travel to client sites for kickoffs, go\-lives, and training — roughly 25–40% of your time, varying with the project calendar.


**Make clients successful**


* Train lab staff on real workflows — accessioning, worklists, QC, reporting, patient portal — and adapt the training to how each lab actually operates.
* Anticipate and manage change resistance: a lab switching its LIS is changing how everyone works, and you will guide them through it.
* Track onboarding health (time\-to\-go\-live, adoption, early ticket volume) and report status honestly to clients and leadership.


**Champion the platform**


* Present and demo CrelioHealth confidently — to the client team that signed, and to the wider staff who did not choose it but must love it.
* Identify expansion opportunities during onboarding (additional modules, locations, or referrals) and hand them to the growth team — with incentives for you when they close.
* Feed what you learn on the ground back into product and our onboarding playbook, which you will help write.


**What We Are Looking For (Must\-haves)**


* **4–7 years of project management experience**, with at least 2 years implementing or onboarding software for external clients.
* **Healthcare experience is required**; hands\-on time in a clinical laboratory or laboratory environment is strongly preferred — as a lab tech, lab manager, LIS analyst, or implementer of lab systems (LIS/LIMS, EHR, RCM).
* Fluency with lab operations concepts: specimen lifecycle, accessioning, QC/QA, instrument interfacing, CLIA/CAP context, HIPAA, and result reporting.
* Excellent presenter and communicator — comfortable running a room of skeptical clinicians, and equally comfortable on a video call with a solo lab owner.
* Structured and self\-managing: you can run multiple concurrent onboardings remotely without anyone chasing you.
* Willingness to travel to client sites across the US; valid driver’s license and authorization to work in the United States.


**Nice\-to\-haves**


* Direct experience with an LIS/LIMS migration or go\-live (any vendor).
* Familiarity with HL7v2 / FHIR interfaces, lab billing/RCM basics, or instrument middleware.
* Experience in customer success, solutions consulting, or pre\-sales — anywhere you have had to win people over, not just manage tasks.
* PMP, CAPM, or Lean Six Sigma is welcome but not required — we care more about go\-lives you have shipped than certificates you hold.
* Comfort using modern AI tools to work faster (drafting plans, summarizing calls, preparing training material) — with the judgment to know what still needs a human.


**How We Hire**



We know polished resumes and cover letters are easy to generate these days, so our process is built around watching you work rather than reading about it. After a screening call, you will do a live onboarding simulation based on a realistic lab scenario, and a short role\-play where you present CrelioHealth to a (friendly but skeptical) “lab director.” No trick questions, no take\-home busywork — just the actual job, compressed. We will respect your time and give you a decision quickly.


**The Fine Print**



CrelioHealth Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.


*The salary range above is a good\-faith estimate for this posting and may vary based on experience, skills, and location within the US.*

jobs.title: Software Training Specialist w/Top Secret Clearance

* Monitor upcoming releases, sprint deliverables, and system changes to proactively assess training impacts and ensure training materials remain aligned with the current production environment.

* Establish and track training effectiveness measures, including attendance, completion, learner feedback, knowledge assessments, and adoption trends, and recommend improvements based on results.
